nodes.body: This branch only works when the instruction carries parsed suffixes. The `lift_cubin_to_ptx` path feeds instructions from `SassDisassembler`, whose 128-bit decoder currently sets `modifiers` to an empty vector and `data_type` to `None`, so a real cubin `IMAD.HI.U32` reaches the final `"IMAD"` arm and is still emitted as `mad.lo`. Populate the SASS suffix metadata during binary decoding (or otherwise route this path through a parser that preserves it) so the fix applies to cubin lifting as well.

The new rejection branch is not covered by the added fixture: all inputs are `.HI.U32`, so a regression could make signed or untyped `IMAD.HI` silently use the unsigned PTX path. Add a focused case such as `IMAD.HI.S32` and assert the diagnostic opcode/message, alongside the positive cases.
